title: 第6章 小老虎被弄疼却变的黏人了-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙照着做，废了九牛二虎之力，脑补出来的小触手还是无法灵活控制去正确的方向。

    谢尘无的脑袋很小幅度的转向了秦夙，温热的呼吸跟着洒落在她耳根，“要我帮帮你？”

    “要，要的！”

    “好，那你别怕，这是我的精神力触手，接受我就好。”

    呃！

    秦夙居然清晰的感觉到，自己想象出的那根细小的触手，被什么东西一下子抓住了！

    而后，那股有些霸道的抓力，真的牵引着她的触手，探到了谢尘无的脖子上，还磨蹭了好几个来回！

    她甚至能通过小触手，感受到谢尘无的皮肤如此光滑，体温正在快速的升高！

    就连他难耐之下，几次吞咽的动作，都像是真的被她摸到了一样，触感清晰到让她头皮一阵发麻！

    耳边又是年轻男人的一声叹息，“呼……”带着细微的颤抖。

    似乎很享受？

    他觉得舒服？

    可为什么一直在蹭？不是说要往他皮肤下面钻进去，再进入他大脑吗？

    秦夙在地球当社畜时，对自己的要求一向是，师父领进门，修行还要靠个人。

    现在，就是她发挥主观能动性的好机会！

    继续闭着眼睛，眉头一皱，把小触手尖端对准谢尘无喉结处，嗖——

    扎了过去！

    “唔……”谢尘无身体剧烈一颤，“别……”

    别什么别？

    秦夙已经戳进去了啊，她抬高一只手去揉一揉上方的白虎耳朵，“嘘……我觉得我已经掌握要领了，你让我试试！”

    耳朵的手感实在厚实又柔韧，秦夙想，这跟撸猫也没什么太大区别嘛~

    “不……不行……不是这里！”谢尘无抓住秦夙的手腕，急切又无助的催她，“快点出来！”

    啊？还有位置分别？

    秦夙生怕自己误操作把这么大一个小帅哥给弄出个三长两短来。

    急匆匆睁开眼，结果一眼就看到从自己右手手腕处伸出去一根红色的细线，正深深扎进谢尘无的喉咙里！

    那条线鲜红如血，吓的她猛地把手一缩！

    红线仿佛承受不住拉力，忽的崩断！

    跟她手腕相连的部分，倏地钻回了自己身体。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Qin Su did as he was told, but despite all his efforts, the small tentacles made up in his head still couldn't be flexibly controlled to move in the right direction.

Xie Chenwu’s head turned slightly towards Qin Su, and his warm breath fell on her ears, “Want me to help you?”

"I want it, I want it!"

"Okay, don't be afraid, this is my spiritual tentacle, just accept me."

Uh!

Qin Su actually clearly felt that the tiny tentacle he had imagined was grabbed by something!

Then, that somewhat overbearing grip really pulled her tentacles to Xie Chenwu's neck, and even rubbed her back and forth several times!

She could even feel through her small tentacles that Xie Chenwu's skin was so smooth and her body temperature was rising rapidly!

Even when he was unbearable, he swallowed several times, as if he was really touched by her. The touch was so clear that it made her scalp tingle!

There was another sigh from the young man in my ears, "Huh..." with a slight tremor.

You seem to be enjoying it?

Does he feel comfortable?

But why do you keep fussing?Didn't you mean to get under his skin and then enter his brain?

When Qin Su was a social animal on Earth, his requirement for himself was that he should be led in by his master, and his cultivation had to rely on himself.

Now is a good opportunity for her to show her subjective initiative!

​​Continuing to close his eyes, he frowned, pointed the tip of the small tentacle at Xie Chenwu's Adam's apple, and whoosh——

Pricked through!

"Well..." Xie Chenwu's body trembled violently, "Don't..."

What else?

Qin Su has already penetrated it. She raised one hand to rub the white tiger ear above, "Shh... I think I have mastered the key. Let me try it!"

The ears feel really thick and flexible. Qin Su thought, this is not much different from petting a cat~

"No...no...not here!" Xie Chenwu grabbed Qin Su's wrist and urged her eagerly and helplessly, "Come out quickly!"

Huh?Is there any location difference?

Qin Su was afraid that he would make a mistake by making a mistake for such a handsome guy.

He hurriedly opened his eyes, only to see a thin red thread extending from his right wrist, piercing deeply into Xie Chenwu's throat!

The line was as red as blood, and she was so frightened that she suddenly retracted her hand!

The red line seemed to be unable to withstand the tension and suddenly broke!

The part connected to her wrist quickly slipped back into her body.
